title: Experts disagree on HUD band
context:
Chief architect: Ruled by the chief, no question needed: these are two separate tests on the same band, not a disagreement. One proves a mid-run message keeps Feature development and the recorded lane; the other proves the row count stays the same across permission, running and verdict states.

Target: HUD band
- qa-engineer: Given an open full-lane change with a running stage, when a non-code message is routed to project-question, then the band stays Feature development and the route line never names a lane lower than the recorded lane.
- qa-engineer: Given the headline moves between permission, running and verdict states, then the band keeps the same row count; proof is a render test asserting row count across the three states, not a visual check.
